title: DOW-UAP-D097, Project Sign Progress Report, 1948
doc_notes: This is a Project Sign progress report from 1948 containing a tabulation of UAP incident reports and technical evaluations of reported craft characteristics.

encounters.summary: A pilot reported a disc-shaped object that oscillated and performed maneuvers, including a high-speed climb.
encounters.quote: Descended from an intermediate altitude in an oscillating fashion almost to the ground

encounters.summary: A pilot reported a disc-shaped object that performed maneuvers and was observed to have a metallic appearance.
encounters.quote: Straight line formation; last disc fluttered very rapidly in side-way arc

encounters.summary: A pilot reported a disc-shaped object that was observed to oscillate and change shape.
encounters.quote: Discs would oscillate and sometimes a full disc would be visible, then a half-moon shape

encounters.summary: A pilot reported a disc-shaped object that performed maneuvers and was observed to have a metallic appearance.
encounters.quote: Thin and smooth on bottom, rough appearing on top
